server_mode.description: If true, run qperf as a server listener. If false, run as a client.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP of the qperf server to connect to (client mode only).

listen_port.description: The TCP port qperf listens on (server) or connects to (client). Default 19765.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for various operations. Default 5.

msg_size.description: Message size for tests. Use numeric bytes or suffixes like '1K', '1M'. Default varies by test.

cpu_affinity.description: CPU affinity setting. Can be a CPU number (e.g., '0') or 'any'. Default empty.

tests.description: List of qperf tests to run (e.g., tcp_bw, udp_lat, rc_lat). See man page TESTS section for valid names.
